race.comment: BOW RIBBON (5) is a lightly tried 7YO gelding who resumed as the favourite at Echuca 2 weeks ago and charged late to finish second by a neck. He meets a similar field and can go one better. ROYAL HERITAGE (11) overcame a slow start when running on powerfully late to just miss winning by a head at Kilmore 2 and a half weeks ago. He will be hoping for the gaps to appear again here and could have the last say this time. STRIKE FIRST (10) was an overdue winner last season and resumes from a spell with a couple of jump-outs under his belt. Keep safe in all top 4 combos. INTO YOU (6) will be peaking third up from a spell, drops in class, dons the blinkers for the first time, and a form reversal is on the cards. WINNING TOAST (3) will be nearing his best again third up from a spell, and with the blinkers on for the first time, he can figure in the top 4 here.
